findings.title: Verify Electrical Provisions Prior to Rough-In
findings.obs: Verify electrical provisions for load, voltage, phase, and frequency with cut sheets prior to rough-in.

findings.title: Potential Insulation R-Value Specification
findings.obs: The wall sections specify batt insulation but do not detail the R-value.

findings.title: Cladding Material Description
findings.obs: The notes indicate different siding materials (e.g., 'brick' and 'precast'), but the drawing sections do not consistently show these materials aligned with their descriptions.

findings.title: Exterior Wall Assembly Clarity
findings.obs: Notes on wall assemblies and exterior glazing are extensive, but do not reference specific construction methods or proprietary systems.

findings.title: Travel Distance Exceeds Typical Thresholds
findings.obs: The travel distance calculated for the second floor is marked as 365 feet, which exceeds common travel distance limits.

findings.title: Exit Signage Details Not Visible
findings.obs: Exit signage locations are not visibly detailed in the egress plans.

findings.title: Occupant Load Calculations
findings.obs: Occupant load calculations for areas with fixed seating are provided but should be verified for accuracy.

findings.title: ADA Compliance Notations
findings.obs: Notes indicate ADA compliance for specified seating without detailed specifications visible.

findings.title: Insulation Specification
findings.obs: The sheet notes insulation as R-20 and R-30 but does not specify the type or specific product.

findings.title: Connection Details
findings.obs: Connection details between new and existing structural elements are shown generally but may require further structural engineering review.

findings.title: Lack of Demolition Sequence Details
findings.obs: The sheet lacks specific demolition sequence details which could lead to safety concerns during execution.

findings.title: Reference to Safety Standards
findings.obs: Demolition elevation notes mention compliance with safety standards but do not specify procedures.

findings.title: Seating Arrangement with ADA Compliance
findings.obs: The sheet shows tagged seating areas with annotations for ADA compliance.

findings.title: Lack of Detailed Equipment Specifications
findings.obs: The equipment plan lacks specific equipment model numbers or specifications necessary for a thorough review.

findings.title: Keynote citation needs confirmation
findings.obs: The finding cites a keyed-note number that is not supported by the quoted drawing evidence. The note citation and the numbered note text on the sheet need to agree.

findings.title: Incomplete Connection Details
findings.obs: The drawing shows several connections labeled as 'CONNECTION 1', 'CONNECTION 2', etc., with a note to verify existing dimensions and steel beam positions ('EXISTING HSS STEEL BEAM:

findings.title: Unspecified Material Properties
findings.obs: The wall sections refer to 'ZEB SYSTEM: 89 MM STEEL STRUCTURAL STUDS', but do not specify material grade or coating type.

findings.title: Incomplete Emergency Lighting Provision Details
findings.obs: Sheet notes require that emergency lighting is designed per NFPA 101 to maintain 1 foot-candle in path of egress. However, specific lighting levels or locations are not detailed on

findings.title: Inverter Capability Description
findings.obs: The sheet states that inverters should illuminate fixtures for 1.5 hours to comply with NEC Section 700 and UL924, but details of backup power capability are not shown here.

findings.title: Coordination with McDonald's ACM
findings.obs: Emergency lighting placement is to be verified with McDonald's ACM, but specific coordination steps are not outlined here.

findings.title: Lack of Scale for Detail Drawings
findings.obs: All details on the sheet are marked as 'SCALE: N.T.S.' (Not to Scale), which may hinder precise understanding of detail sizing and proportion if not referenced elsewhere.

findings.title: Revision Dates and Labeling
findings.obs: The revision block shows a revision date of 10/15/26, which is unusually futuristic and might be a typographical error.

findings.title: Professional Certification Note
findings.obs: The drawing includes a professional certification that the documents were prepared by a duly licensed architect in DC.

findings.title: Glazing Labeling Requirements
findings.obs: Sheet includes note indicating that all glass must be permanently labeled in accordance with ANSI Z97.1 or 16 CFR 1201, as noted in the GENERAL GLAZING NOTES section.

findings.title: Safety Glazing in Hazardous Locations
findings.obs: Sheet contains a note that specifies windows and glass doors shall be of safety glass where required by code.

findings.title: Verification of Local Code Compliance
findings.obs: Several notes state 'BSI TO MAKE FINAL CONN PER LOCAL CODES.' The extent of local code compliance must be confirmed.

findings.title: Backflow Preventer Connection Verification
findings.obs: Note specifies 'BSI TO MAKE CONNECTION FROM BACKFLOW PREVENTER.' Ensure backflow prevention is compliant.

findings.title: Verification of Chase Installation
findings.obs: Items such as 021.01P1 mention installations 'DN CHASE,' and alternatives if no chase exists. Clarification on the chase availability and installation method is advisable.

findings.title: Reference to Other Sheet for Filtration System Detail
findings.obs: The drawing includes a note 'TO FILTRATION SYSTEM SEE DETAIL 5 ON SHEET P-3.0' indicating further details on another sheet.

findings.title: Water Pressure and Flow Rate Verification
findings.obs: Flow rates are indicated next to some of the fixtures, such as "1/2" (1.0 GPM)' and '3/4" (2.0 GPM)', which may require verification against design criteria and code requirements.

findings.title: GFCI Protection Note
findings.obs: The drawing includes a note specifying that GFCI protection is required for electrical outlets located within 6 feet of a water source.

findings.title: Lack of Detailed Fire Safety Measures
findings.obs: The sheet does not contain detailed information about fire safety measures such as fire suppression systems or clear egress pathways related to the front counter area.

findings.title: Inconsistent Plan/Section Indications
findings.obs: There is an inconsistency in the labeling between plan and sectional views for the section at the delivery pod.

findings.title: Missing Dimension for Wall Detail
findings.obs: Wall section 1 is missing a specified dimension for existing roof height.

findings.title: Clarification on Connection Details Required
findings.obs: Connection 2 details multiple components without clear identification on sequence or attachment specifics.

findings.title: Coordination of Structural Supports
findings.obs: Supporting steel beams in Wall Section 3 require coordination with existing utilities.

findings.title: General Notes Section
findings.obs: The general notes section provides typical requirements for ceiling installations, including references to other sheets for details.

findings.title: Revisions Date Conflict
findings.obs: The revisions area shows a future date of '10/15/26' which appears after the '10/15/2026' permit set date noted below it.

findings.title: Incomplete Detail Reference
findings.obs: Notes refer to 'SEE A2.00 FOR FINISH LEGEND', which is not detailed on this sheet.

findings.title: Connection Details
findings.obs: The drawing shows 'EXTEND AND CONNECT TO NEAREST SANITARY SEWER' without further specific connection details.

findings.title: Grease Interceptor Placement
findings.obs: Text states 'SANITARY SEWER SHALL NOT CONNECT UPSTREAM OF GREASE INTERCEPTOR,' but the grease interceptor location is not shown.

findings.title: Absence of specific NEC code references
findings.obs: The electrical notes and diagrams do not reference specific 2014 NEC code sections for compliance.

findings.title: Verification of McDonald's POS specifications compliance
findings.obs: The sheet includes specifications and checklists to ensure compliance with McDonald's requirements but lacks third-party verification stamps.

findings.title: Lack of specific duct size details
findings.obs: The plan shows multiple ducts with sizes indicated, but lacks comprehensive information for all sections. For example, there are large areas where duct sizes are not specified.

findings.title: Inconsistent symbol usage for equipment
findings.obs: Some equipment symbols do not match typical conventions or are not explained by the symbol legend.

findings.title: Lack of detail on airflow direction
findings.obs: The drawing indicates supply and return ductwork but lacks explicit arrows or designations showing the airflow direction.

findings.title: Coordination with structural plan required
findings.obs: Mechanical duct pathways are extensive and may require coordination with structural elements to avoid conflicts.

findings.title: Unlabeled Fixture Types
findings.obs: The Toilet Room Fixture Plan (Item 2) does not label specific types of fixtures such as urinals or sinks.

findings.title: Accessibility Signage Height
findings.obs: The Signage Height Elevation (Item 4) includes notes on compliant signage heights per ADA guidelines.

findings.title: Door Dimensions and Clearance
findings.obs: Toilet room door clearances are shown differently between Toilet Room Plan (Item 1) and Fixture Plan (Item 2).

findings.title: Toilet Room Accessories
findings.obs: Accessory schedule notes installation requirements for ADA compliance.

findings.title: Field Verification Note
findings.obs: General notes call for field verification of toilet room dimensions before installation.

findings.title: Absence of Glass Labeling Details
findings.obs: The 'LABELING OF GLASS' section is noted but lacks specific requirements or labeling specifications.

findings.title: Safety Glazing Specifications
findings.obs: Safety notes are provided under the ‘1A SAFETY NOTES’ but lack specific references to applicable codes or standards regarding safety glazing.

findings.title: Incomplete window detail specifications
findings.obs: Window sill and head details do not specify material or insulation requirements.

findings.title: Structural bracing detail
findings.obs: The diagonal bracing detail lacks specific information on connections and materials.

findings.title: Roof drainage detail
findings.obs: The parapet detail includes a note on transparent drainage pipe but lacks routing details.
